Hi Rishi / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to get Greenline set up as an approved supplier so we can start routing POs for the upcoming pilot. To keep procurement moving on our side, could you confirm the following?

- Primary contact for invoicing and vendor setup at Redwood (name/email)
- Preferred invoicing method (email, EDI, portal) and billing email address
- Any required vendor paperwork (W-9, vendor agreement, tax forms) and whether you accept DocuSign
- A sample PO format or a reference to your PO terms (net terms, currency)
- Expected lead time for first PO issuance after vendor approval

If easier, I can fill your vendor questionnaire directly — just point me to it. We’re hoping to receive the first PO by the first week of December.

Attached: our company vendor contact sheet (for your records).

Best,
Mira

Procurement Lead

Hi Mira —

Thanks — welcome aboard. I’ve looped in Laura (Procurement Ops) and Vanessa (Finance lead) to help with the paperwork and PO specifics. Quick answers below and a checklist attached to make the handoff tighter.

What we need from Greenline (please return to procure@redwood.com):
- Completed vendor questionnaire (attached: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx)
- Valid W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) and bank details for ACH (PDF or bank letter)
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable for services)
- Signed vendor agreement (we can send a DocuSign link)
- Vendor point of contact for invoices and billing email

What we’ll provide / next steps from Redwood:
- Vendor activation form to populate our ERP (we will create the supplier record once we have the questionnaire + W-9)
- Sample PO (see attached sample_po_template.pdf) — Redwood POs are generated from our ERP and include a PO number, line items, and a URL to the acceptance terms.
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 from receipt of correct invoice (exceptions can be requested via vendor ops)
- Preferred invoice submission: invoices@redwood.com (PDF) — we do not currently accept EDI for small pilots; portal onboarding is available for larger volume suppliers.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, sample_po_template.pdf, vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

Can you share the W-9 and ACH details by end of day Tuesday so Laura can kick the activation? If you prefer, we’ll send the DocuSign vendor agreement now so you can sign electronically.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Thanks Rishi — that’s clear. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) DocuSign is fine — please send the agreement link and we’ll get it signed today.
2) For bank details, we prefer providing a bank letter; is that acceptable or do you require a voided check?
3) On the PO terms — will Redwood accept invoices dated from the service completion date, or do you require invoice dates to match PO date? We want to align our billing system.

I’ll return the completed questionnaire and W-9 by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Mira

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier registration & PO enablement — info request

Hi Mira —

Good to meet you virtually. A few operational notes from Procurement Ops:

- Bank proof: bank letter is acceptable for ACH. We only request a voided check if the bank letter is unavailable.
- Invoice date: Redwood accepts invoices dated on or after the service completion date; invoice must reference the PO number and include the billing contact. If invoice date precedes PO date, it triggers an exception and delays payment.
- DocuSign: please sign the vendor agreement and return — once we receive the signed agreement + W-9 + questionnaire, we’ll open a supplier record in our ERP (Coupa-backend) and generate the first PO. Typical activation SLAs: 3 business days after complete docs are received.
- If your legal requires any redlines, send them back to legal@redwood.com with the subject line: Vendor Agreement — Greenline (attention: Contract Ops). We handle small redline requests within 2–3 business days.

I’ve added a few internal action owners below:
- Laura Bennett (procurement ops): will create supplier record and confirm PO issuance
- Vanessa Ortiz (finance): will set payment terms and validate bank details

If you’d like a short call to walk through the checklist live, I can do 11/30 at 10:00am PT.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
